clips.prompt:
Subject: Landscape 16:9, one continuous 11-second single-character narrative. Show exactly one physical instance of the established heavy adult adventurer from Picture 1 and no other human-shaped figure anywhere in the frame. Preserve his broad heavy body, grounded weight, short dark hair, thick dark beard, tired experienced face, layered worn dark clothing, red scarf, crossing straps and buckles, pale metal shoulder and chest structure, complete backpack and rolled equipment, one cyan-lit waist lantern, heavy gloves and boots. Keep every connected item, body proportion, material and reference color unchanged.

Movement: From 0 to 2 seconds he is already standing in a valid stable position, both boots planted, his complete load and all hanging equipment settled. From 2 to 4 seconds one ordinary nonverbal mechanical cycle cue occurs off frame from the verified open side; there is no alarm, visible operator or new mechanism. From 4 to 6 seconds only the nearest shoulder and attached equipment make one restrained local response while his feet remain planted. From 6 to 8 seconds his eyes and head turn only slightly to check the lateral space beside his load. From 8 to 10 seconds, without stepping backward, he deliberately shifts sideways by roughly half the width of one boot into verified open ground. From 10 to 11 seconds he stops immediately; the backpack and hanging equipment settle once, and he remains calm and stable without further correction.

Scene: Picture 2 defines SCENE-05, the same monochrome mechanical-airport environment, its existing structures, spatial continuity, safe standing area, negative space and original palette logic. Use one empty operational bay from the bound scene. The entire visible background, glass, screens, doorways, walkways and reflective surfaces must contain zero people, zero human silhouettes, zero staff, zero passengers and zero person-like reflections. Environmental activity is conveyed only by restrained sound and an existing off-frame cycle cue. Do not invent a door, control panel, display, sign, rail, platform, warning light, extra machine or alternate route.

Camera: One locked eye-level full-body medium-wide three-quarter view in a 16:9 landscape frame. Keep both boots, backpack width, hanging equipment, verified side clearance and stable ground readable together. Fixed framing, focal length and horizon; no push, pull, pan, tilt, tracking, reframing, cut, transition or split screen. The foreground adventurer is the only human-shaped subject from first frame to last frame.

Lighting: Preserve the bound character materials and Picture 2's monochrome palette logic. Use one fixed soft diffuse light throughout. Keep the cyan lantern as one small identity light only. No new glow, flashing, relighting, weather change, sudden saturation shift or color redesign.

Atmosphere: He first reads as competent and correctly positioned; the tiny voluntary side shift reads as experienced consideration rather than indecision or retreat. The empty airport bay keeps attention on his weight, timing and one precise lateral transfer. Use clear two-dimensional hand-drawn shapes, restrained variable-width linework, soft diffuse depth and low-saturation shadows only where compatible with the bound references.

Audio: Ambient soundscape: low empty mechanical-airport room tone, restrained ventilation, one ordinary non-alarm off-frame cycle cue, slight equipment creak, one lateral boot contact and a single backpack-settling sound. Emotional sound cue: one sparse low sustained tone remains quiet during the clearance check and resolves softly when the new stance settles, with no lyrics and no strong beat. Audio supports spatial margin, weight transfer and restrained emotion only; it does not imply unseen people, drive cuts or become music-video editing.

Negative: exactly one character and one physical body, no duplicate character, no second human figure, no split screen, no clone or mirror-double, no reflection person, no crowd, no NPC, no background human silhouette, no repeated human shape, no extra limbs, no text overlay, no watermark, no abrupt redesign, no young slim redesign, no removed backpack, no dropped equipment, no duplicate lantern, no new strap, no new buckle, no new weapon, no backward step, no repeated shuffling, no panic, no run, no jump, no acrobatics, no visible operator, no invented mechanism or structure, no camera movement, no cut, no transition, no weather change, no abrupt color shift, no lyrics, no strong beat, no MV editing, no glossy 3D rendering.
